description: This file defines the internal class CosmosGatewayListProvider, which implements the IGatewayListProvider interface for managing and retrieving a list of gateway URIs from an Azure Cosmos DB database as part of Orleans clustering.

classes.name: CosmosGatewayListProvider
classes.description: Implements the IGatewayListProvider interface, responsible for fetching gateway URIs from Cosmos DB in a Orleans clustering setup.

methods.name: CosmosGatewayListProvider
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the provider with dependencies, options, and sets up configuration parameters.

methods.name: InitializeGatewayListProvider
methods.description: Initializes the Cosmos client and container for querying.

methods.name: GetGateways
methods.description: Fetches the list of active gateway URIs from Cosmos DB.

methods.name: ConvertToGatewayUri
methods.description: Converts a SiloEntity object into a gateway URI.

methods.name: LogErrorInitializingGatewayListProvider
methods.description: Logs an error if initialization of the gateway list provider fails.

methods.name: LogErrorReadingGatewayListFromCosmosDb
methods.description: Logs an error if reading the gateway list from Cosmos DB fails.
